definition.en: The Global Foreign Exchange Committee (GFXC) is a forum of central banks and private sector participants established to promote, facilitate, and maintain the integrity and effective functioning of the global wholesale foreign exchange market.
definition.hi: The Global Foreign Exchange Committee (GFXC) is a forum of central banks and private sector participants established to promote, facilitate, and maintain the integrity and effective functioning of the global wholesale foreign exchange market.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, understanding the GFXC is crucial for analyzing international financial standards and the role of the RBI in global regulatory frameworks. It highlights how India aligns its domestic forex market practices with international codes of conduct like the FX Global Code.
importanceInUpsc.hi: For UPSC GS-3, understanding the GFXC is crucial for analyzing international financial standards and the role of the RBI in global regulatory frameworks. It highlights how India aligns its domestic forex market practices with international codes of conduct like the FX Global Code.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the role of the GFXC in setting global standards for the foreign exchange market.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the role of the GFXC in setting global standards for the foreign exchange market.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of the FX Global Code on the Indian financial system and RBI policies.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the impact of the FX Global Code on the Indian financial system and RBI policies.

prerequisites.en: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)
